code_examples.section: ltm rule command DHCPv6 link address
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

DHCPv6::link_address
       This command returns link address field from DHCPv6 RELAY message.

SYNOPSIS
       DHCPv6::link_address

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns link address field from DHCPv6 RELAY message

       Details (syntax): DHCPv6::link_address

RETURN VALUE
       This command returns link address field from DHCPv6 RELAY message

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_DATA {
	    log local0. "Link_address [DHCPv6::link_address]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	    --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
